# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
The purpose of this document is to bring reliability in the UI specifically with Import Purchase.

# Business Requirement
Certainly, in order to make the UI more interactive and efficient with regards to Advance License sub-module Enhancement for import purchase.

# Scope
The Scope of these specs is to enhance the below screens:-
• Supplier PI List
• Advance license List
• Souricng ASN New/List
• BOE New/List
• Tax Payment
• Duty Script Movement

# Section 2. Assumptions
• No Assumptions

# Section 3. Functional Requirement Description

## Screen 01 | Supplier Indent List
Path: Sourcing > Supplier PI > Supplier PI List

#### Requirement 01 :-
• Need an additional serial no. to be generated at supplier PI level.
• Need the nomenclature composition to be configured from system coding
• Its visibility should be controlled through Screen layout configurator.
• Column Name : “Transaction No.”

#### Requirement 02 :-
• Need a column “Duty Claim”
• Multi selection will be allowed,
• when user choose Duty Exempt, it will enable the next column “Import Duty Benefit Basis” and populate “Advance License” for selection. (detailed below)
• when user select Duty Paid, it will enable the above same column “Import Duty Benefit Basis” and populate “Export Scheme” for selection. (detailed below)
• Where user select both Duty Free/Duty Paid it will select both license apportion along with its export scheme.
• Columns visibility should be controlled through Screen layout configurator
• Updated info in this memo will be saved through Update info utility tool (detailed below)
• Column should be search feasibility.
• Need a column “Import Duty Benefit Basis”,
• Column visibility should be controlled through Screen layout configurator.
• Wherein the DDL value for column Duty Claim as “Duty Exempt” then this will auto populate the value “Advance License” and will get freezed.
• Wherein the DDL value for column Duty Claim as “Duty Paid” then this will provide the options to be selected by the user
• Export Scheme
• Cash/Bank
• Multiple selection to be allowed.
• Column should be search feasibility
• Need a column “Import Duty Benefit Reference”,
• By default it will show “ >>”
• If the Import Duty Benefit Basis is selected and no reference is attached then this will get highlighted and will appear in “Red”
• Soon after the allocation is successfully done than this “>>” will start showing the attached license/scroll no..
• In case of multiple number it will show all the numbers through hovering over.
• Columns visibility should be controlled through Screen layout configurator
• It should support search feasibility.
• Wherein the DDL value for Import Duty Benefit Basis = Advance License,
• Through the above “>>” user can access pop window to attach the Articlewise allocation details.
• “Import duty Benefit Basis” will provide a row splitter inorder to align multiple basis in one line.
• “Import duty Benefit reference” will provide a row splitter inorder to align multiple license, scroll or both as the per the case.
• User need to open this Divv and save the details
• A Copy below tool is also required at each above column at line level
• Required Columns:

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 13 rows · columns: Attributes (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Attributes]
| Attributes | Description |
| PO Number | It will display the PO Number |
| Article | It will display the Article name from PO |
| Color | It will display the color name from PO |
| Size | It will display the size from PO |
| Qty | It will display its qty from PO |
| Rate | It will display its rate from PO |
| Value | It will display its value from PO |
| Import Duty Benefit Basis | Advance License / Export Scheme |
| Import Duty Benefit reference | License no./RoSCTL/RoDTEP |
| Sanctioned SQM/Value | It will get the render the total value as per license master/Scrip |
| Apportioned SQM/Value | It will display the total value of already consumed license value/Scrip under the criteria |
| Available SQM/Value | It will show the sanctioned value – apportioned value for the criteria |
| Utilized SQM/Value | It will auto populate the required value as per the line criteria subject to that the available value should be there, if not then it will populate available value (refer Multi License/scroll allocation sheet) |
• Required Utility tools:-
• Save : to save the changes
• Discard : to discard the changes
• Exit : to close the pop-up without closing
• Import : to import the allocation specified format
• Export : to export the specified import format for above.
• Wherein the DDL value for Import Duty Benefit Basis = Export Scheme,
• it will provide the Scroll no. for selection
• RoSCTL/RoDTEP scripts on the Duty script screen with status = Ready for Utilization
• As per the division tagged in the scroll, it will appear for selection in that division as per logged in division.
• System not allow to clubs RoSCTL/RoDTEP scroll together.
• Multiple License/Scroll allocation logic for reference
• These allocation details will be saved at backend at item/color/size/HSN level for further report purposes including the details at PO/Supplier PI/Production reference no./GRN level which will be used for export incentive reconciliation and will be to Sales ASN late
Requirement 03 :-
• A utility tool is required in order to update the values at these three fields. “UPDATE INFO”
• Logs for all the updates is required to be maintained.
• Its visibility should be controlled through user program permissions

## Screen 02 | Advance License Master – List
Path: Sales > Advance License > List
• Need column to display the attached Supplier PI no. along with Production reference no. in bracket of the supplier pi against which this license have been attached.
• It will act as hyperlink where user can click and access PO Articlewise allocation details from the supplier PI list screen for that particular supplier PI.
• Its visibility to be controlled from Screen layout configurator

## Screen 03 | Advance Shipment Notice
Path: Sourcing > Charge backs > Sourcing ASN > New / List
Requirement 01 :-
• Order Type : Supplier PI
• While adding shipping details need column to filter the above “Transaction no.” in the Supplier PI list screen.
• This would be generic i.e. if this column is enabled then this will appear here.
• Sourcing ASN need to aligned with approver in order to get confirmed and aligned to appear in the BOE creation.
• All logistics related details will be updated below on ASN (No change only for reference)
Requirement 02 :-
• Need an option in the Utility tool to generate BOE against the Advance shipment note
• Multiple ASN can be selected to generate the BOE
• BOE generation screen detailed below, Screen 04
• This utility tool should be controlled from User program permission.

## Screen 04 | Bill of entry
To be Path: Sourcing > Bill of Entry > New / List
Requirement 01 :- New
• This can only created against import ASN.
• Need a new screen to create a BILL OF ENTRY transaction in correspondence to facilitate for Indian statutory compliance requirements over import of goods.
• This screen will provide 5 segments :
• Header

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 3 rows · columns: Field Name (text), Behaviour (text), Description (text)]
| Field Name | Behaviour | Description |
| Supplier | Dropdown | It will enlist all foreign suppliers with existing import order. |
| BOE No. | User input | It will be input by the user while creating the BOE or else later from the BOE list screen. |
| BOE Date | Conditional editable | It will become editable on putting BOE no. and It will be input by the user while creating the BOE or else later from the list screen |
• Bill of Entry Information

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 10 rows · columns: Field Name (text), Behaviour (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Field Name]
| Field Name | Behaviour | Description |
| Invoice no. | Text box | It will be text box with alphanumeric compatibility to input supplier invoice number. |
| Authorized Dealer Code | Dropdown | It will provide list from bank master |
| My Billing Address | Dropdown | It will provide list of all recipient billing address |
| Document Type | Fixed / Read-only | it will be freezed and by default = Import |
| Allocate GST Charges | System-driven | it will follow the ongoing generic behavior call the GST tax template based on the above My billing Address + Document type |
| IGM No. | Text box | It will be text box with alphanumeric compatibility, default 50 digit limit where no duplicacy should be allowed |
| IGM Date | Date selection | it will be provide user to attach date |
| IGCR Bond no. | Text box | It will be text box with alphanumeric compatibility to input IGCR bond no. under which import license for concessional rate. |
| License Details | hyperlink | (Detailed below) |
| Port Of Discharge/Delivery | Dropdown | It will provide list of Port from Port master |
License Details:
• It will provide the license consumption details

| Article Description | This will be manual input alphanumeric field with maximum count of 200 alphabets |

| UOM | It will display UOM from the ASN |
| ASN Qty | It will display the line Qty from the ASN |

Need a use permission to make it editable in the form of drop to select any other license no associating to that Article color size UOM combination. |

(Available SQM) |
| ASN Qty (Sq Mtrs) | It will auto-populate from PO Articlewise allocation details on Supplier PI list screen
(Utilized SQM) |
| License Utilized Value | ASN Qty Sq mtrs * rate (from the license master of that particular article/color/size ) |
• Shipment Logistics Details
• Utility tools to Add and delete shipment will be available on this section, through which all the Import ASN for the above supplier against which BOE has not been generated will be available for selection.
• It will provide the ASN level logistics details for the all the attached ASNs.
• Below details for each ASN will be available in the columnar way
• Mother/Feeder Vessel no.:
• Voyage no.:
• Port of Loading:
• Port of Discharge:
• House B/L No.:
• Master B/L No.:
• Delivery Terms:
• ETD :
• ETA :
• House B/L Date:
• Master B/L Date:
• License no.
• Transaction no.(Supplier PI)
• Articlewise Import Duty Allocation details :
• It will provide a comprehensive Artcile+Color+Size+HSN details of the items in getting imported in the ASN.
• It will get auto-populated as soon as ASN is selected in the heade

[TABLE 5: Table 5 · 11 rows · columns: Attributes (text), Behaviour (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Attributes]
| Attributes | Behaviour | Description |

| Amt IGST INPUT | System calculated / Editable | It will show the Multiplicated value of (Taxable Value * % IGST INPUT) It will be Editable |
• Values for GST % and Amt at each line should be auto-filled when user will click on the Allocate GST Charges based on My billing address and Doc Type.
• Need a user level permission to make the HSN code editable at the above Articlewise Import duty allocation details section. It will be drop-down rendering valued from the HSN code master.
• Comments & Attachment : UI default behavior
• All section along with screen should be available through Screen layout configurator
• All sections along with screen should be flex-filed compatible
• All sections will have Freeze column feasibility.
• As soon as the BOE no. and BOE date is attached, it should get auto synced at its corresponding ASN list fields i.e. Custom Declaration no. ; Custom Declaration Date:
Requirement 02 :- List
• Utility tool required and should be available in the user program permissions :-
• New : to direct to BOE creation screen
• Save : in order to save any changes made from the list screen
• Cancel : to cancel the transaction. Post GRN creation BOE cannot be cancelled
• Revise : In order to revise the selected line. Post GRN creation BOE cannot be cancelled
• Log : to view details of all the saved changes in the default format
• Revision log: to view version wise changes on the selected line on each revision.
• Print / Bi Print : To extract the transaction details on pdf or printer
• Export to excel : Extract the complete details in excel
• Update flex fields : UI generic behavior, it will enlist all the flex-filed to update
• Required Columns :-

It will be editable and user can input here the interest paid.

It will be editable and user can input here the interest paid.
It will get freezed post payment is done |

| Sent for Payment | It will be blank
It will reflect the date on which the system auto-trigger the import duty payment drat in F&A Module (detailed below in Screen 04, requirement 03) |
| Division Name | it will be reflect the name of the division in which the BOE is created |
| Flex field | UI generic behaviour |
| Out-of-Charge No. | It will be enabled post the only for the files where the SENT TO PAYMENT dates have been filed.
It will provide an alphanumeric textbox for user to input the OCC number generated at icegate.
No duplicasy allowed. |
| Out-of-charge date | It will get enabled from above OOC no. values filled and allow user to put OOC date |
| Status | Save : UI generic behavior, BOE will be saved as draft.
Waiting: BOE confirmed but BOE no. and date not updated.
Confirmed : BOE is confirmed and BOE no. is attached |
| Created on | It will store the created on date of the BOE |
| Created by | It will store the created by username of the BOE |
| Confirmed on | It will store the confirmed on date of the BOE |
| Confirmed by | It will store the confirmed by username of the BOE |
| Payment date & time | It will reflect the payment date of the above BOE request has been paid |
| Payment no. | It will reflect the payment voucher no. and will act a hyperlink to access the payment voucher view |
| Import Duty Benefit Basis | This will reflect the Scheme selection made by the user at the supplier PI screen (Advance License/Export scheme /BANK)
It will only be visible for reference and will be uneditable. |
| Export Scheme Details | Through option user will be able to access the above attached Scroll details at PI level re confirm it here |
• As soon as BOE is updated to Confirmed status then system should automatically push to create a import duty payment entry based on the BOE in F&A Module.
• Its columns visibility to be controlled from Screen Layout Configurator
• As soon as the BOE no. and BOE date is attached, it should get auto synced at the ASN no. fields i.e. Custom Declaration no.:, Custom Declaration Date:
Requirement 03 :- List
• As soon as the BOE status is updated to confirmed and Scheme selection is Bank/Cash then a payment request will be triggered for the payment of the import custom duty agaisnt this BOE and the trigger date/BOE conifrmation date will be locked here
• The above BOE will start apprating in the outstanding screen GST tab in tax payment (handelling on tax payment detailed in below Screen 05).
• OOC No. and OOC date will become editable as soon as sent for payment date is filled
Screen 05 | Tax Payment
Path : FA >> Taxation & Compliances >> Tax Payment >> New
Requirement :-
• Any request pushed from the BOE List screen will start appearing on the tax payment screen for processing the payment of import duty.
• Attributes Specification:-
• Transaction Type : Import Duty payment
• GST Type : IGST
• Rest no change wherever the info is available will reflect otherwise will be blank.
• Workflow:-
• There will the payment processing workflow will be same, user can select the request and proceed for payment processing.
Screen 06 | GST Doc Integration
Path: FA > GST Doc integration
Requirement :-
• As soon as the OOC No. and OOC date is update on the BOE the same will be available in the GST doc integration page for generation of Eway bill generation against the same.
• So we need to handle the E-way bill generation through the Clear-Tax integration for Import Inbound – Port to Warehouse Transfer
• As soon as the Sourcing ASN is created and its BOE details (Number and Date) are updated that particular ASN will start appearing on the GST doc integration for generating a E-way bill generation against the same.
• Attributes :-
• Doc type = Import Inbound
• Transaction Type = Port-to-warehouse Transfer
• Update Transfer details : it will be used to update the vehicle details required for Eway bill
• Challan no./date : It will reflect the BOE no./date updated at the ASN list screen
• Rest all details are usual
• These transactions visibility will be controlled through GST event mapping.
Screen 07 | Merchant Sheet – Duty vs License Clearance
Duty vs License Clearance screen is used to decide which clearance mode to be used for import shipments.
This function covers below information:

#### Style based Material information (Import)

#### Selection of Material HS code to drive import duty %

#### Selection of DBK and License Serial Number for Duty paid or License mode clearance calculation
Style Based Material Information is selected on style based individual material procurement request. In WFX, User Indent List will be used for this purpose.
Query=>Shahi team to advise in color or width based clearance mode validation is required?
User Indent List
User will select style based material line and click on “Duty vs License Clearance” link.
On Click on “Duty vs License Clearance” Button, system will open similar screen in WFX with below listed fields.
Query=>Impact of other fields on calculation yet to be clarified by Shahi team.

#### Key Data Entry:
Imp. Ex Rate: Import Exchange Rate to be entered
Imp Item HS Code: Import Item HSCODE will be selected by user for Material. WFX to have Import HSCODE master to facilitate this.
Imp HSCODE %: Import duty % will be auto populated based on HSCODE Selected.
BCD (Basic Custom Duty): This value will be auto populated based on “Fabric Qty” * Fabric Price Per Yrd/ Mtr” * “Imp Ex Rate” i.e. in this case is
1747 x 3.41 x 90.80 = 540920.11
BCD = 54092.01

### Selection on Value under Duty Paid Clearance Mode:
In this screen, values under field number 27, 31 & 35 will be selected by user based on serial number applicable for this import which is based on garment type and material type. These serial number will list from Chapter master data recorded in WFX. Refer sample below:

#### Duty Drawback

#### RoSCTL
Other Fields will be auto populated based on Serial number selected.
For example,
DBK Rate (INR) will auto populate based on serial chapter i.e. 3.3%.
DBK converted Rate will be based on DBK c=percentage of Garment FOB x Exchange rate i.e. 3.65 x 89.10 = 325.15 INR which comes to (3.25.15 x 3%) = 10.73
DBK Cap Value will auto populate as per Serial Number Selected.
Lowest of DBK Converted rate and Cap value will be considered for calculation.

### Selection on Value under License (SAAS) Clearance Mode:
Method of fields value selection and calculation will be the same as “Duty Paid” mode. However, Serial numbers for selection will be driven from SAAS chapter.
Based on above value final summary will be populated as below.
Summary of Clearance Mode Selection
Query=>Calculation of Net amount yet to be clarified by Shahi team.
Based on conclusion, system will auto populate mode of clearance in “Supplier PI list” under column “Import Duty Claim”. User will be able to change if required
